reviews.review_description:
I picked up both the Remastered original and the Gold sequel… Couldn’t be happier with both of em. The upgrades are more noticeable on UW 1 Remastered but that’s only cuz the original was developed on a Quest 1. Ginormous leap from quest 1 graphics/performance to Quest 3 graphics/performance. 
But the Gold sequel is soooo much nicer than than UW2…. The graphics are sharper and the added weather effects are so cool. Seeing it rain and hit the front glass… The weather really is a MAJOR addition. Also, Gold has multiplayer dogfighting… Need I say more? lol. This is the only flying game where air combat feels fair/achievable but not close to being “easy”.   This flying gem strikes the PERFECT balance between Arcade and Sim/Realism.  
With all the hot garbage on the meta store these days it sure was a pleasant surprise seeing both these games. 

Now we need UltraWings 3! Please devs! Make it happen! lol
